2026-10-05.note: First time taking photos with a 'real' camera. Had tons of fun. Saw a beautiful Great Egret hunting for dinner, a couple of ducks being silly, a hawk overlooking the bayou, and a mama alligator sunbathing with her babies.

species.wood-duck: The male Wood Duck is so pretty with its colorful patterns. The female here is a gray-brown with a white eye-ring.

2026-10-06.note: Lovely Tuesday. Spent a lot of time playing around with the camera and looking for small things to capture. I saw a women with her husband and she had a very large and fancy camera. I introduced myself and asked her some questions. She was very friendly. I think I made a friend.

2026-10-09.note: More fun at Black Bayou with the baby alligators.

species.northern-mockingbird: This was obviously not at black bayou haha, this was my back-yard.
species.deer: Although they were beautiful, these two females were NOT happy to see us.

2026-10-10.note: Kiroli is finally back open after lots of damage from the snow storm. It's much more open then it was which made seeing birds in flight quite a bit easier. However, my photography skills are still lacking for moving targets XD.

species.butterfly: Yes, this is a butterfly! It's name is Ocola Skipper. It migrates from the deep south to northern states later in the season and is mostly valued as a pollinator.

species.alligator: We saw two alligators at Black Bayou today. Chloe got a great video of one essentially jumping out of the water and diving back into catch something. It was pretty crazy!
